defs.def: a piece of work that sb has to do, especially a hard or unpleasant one （尤指艰巨或令人厌烦的）任务，工作

ex.s: Emotional states of participants were also measured by asking about their feelings while completing the gallery task.
ex.t: 参与者的情绪状态也通过询问他们在完成画廊任务时的感受来衡量。

ex.s: To examine the difficulty of the tasks.
ex.t: 考察任务难度.

ex.s: Involve your child in the daily running of the house: tidying toys, feeding the dog, watering the plants. ____36____ When the tasks become as routine as brushing teeth, kids internalise that helping with housework is simply part of life.
ex.t: 让孩子参与日常的家务:整理玩具,喂养狗,给植物浇水。 当____36____任务变得像刷牙一样例行公事时,孩子们会内化帮助家务只是生活的一部分。

ex.s: You can’t expect your child to tackle their tasks with enthusiasm while you’re complaining about loading the dishwasher.
ex.t: 你一边抱怨装洗碗机，一边别指望孩子会满怀热情地应对自己的任务。

ex.s: Be demanding on yourself and expect 100 percent attention to the task.
ex.t: 对自己严格要求，要求对任务100%专注。

ex.s: My mum would find fun even when completing the most boring of tasks.
ex.t: 我妈妈会找到乐趣 即使完成最无聊的任务。

ex.s: I realise now that Mum didn’t find the joy in these tasks: she created it.
ex.t: 如今我意识到妈妈并没有找到这些任务的乐趣:她创造了它。

ex.s: Fortunately, analyses suggest that renewables are up to the task.
ex.t: 幸运的是，分析表明可再生能源能担此任。

ex.s: Still, the findings show a potential path forward for reducing microplastic exposure — a task that’s becoming increasingly difficult.
ex.t: 尽管如此，这些发现为减少微塑料摄入指明了一条可行的路径——这是一项正变得愈发困难的任务。

ex.s: And, there are tasks for every age and ability, so all your children can feel proud of their work.
ex.t: 而且，每个年龄段和能力都有任务，所以你所有的孩子都能对自己的工作感到自豪。

ex.s: Naming them is a challenging task.
ex.t: 给它们命名是一项具有挑战性的任务。

ex.s: The benefits of print reading particularly shine through when experimenters move from posing simple tasks — like identifying the main idea in a reading passage — to ones that require mental abstraction — such as drawing inferences from a text.
ex.t: 当实验者从简单任务——比如找出一段阅读材料的主旨——转向需要心智抽象的任务——比如从文本中做推断——时，纸质阅读的优势尤为明显。

ex.s: Start with small tasks
ex.t: 从小任务开始

ex.s: Each week, participants will be asked to complete a topic﹣specific reflection task.
ex.t: 每周，参与者将被要求完成一项特定主题的反思任务。

ex.t: 根据文章，人类一岁幼儿最可能完成哪项任务？

ex.s: To perform these tasks, drones for rail don’t need to be flying overhead.
ex.t: 为了执行这些任务，铁路无人机不需要在头顶飞行。

ex.s: This kind of "distracted focus" appears to be the best state for working on creative tasks.
ex.t: 这种“分心式专注”似乎是最适合做创造性任务的状态。

ex.s: He explained our basic task, the tractor fired up and we were off, riding down the field looking for weeds to spray with chemicals.
ex.t: 他讲解了我们的基本任务，拖拉机发动起来，我们就出发了，沿着田地行驶，寻找要用化学品喷洒的杂草。

ex.s: She wondered if centuries of diving could have led to the evolution of physical characteristics that made the task easier for them.
ex.t: 她想知道几个世纪的潜水能否导致身体特征的演化,使得他们的任务更容易完成.

ex.s: 26.Instead of getting down to a new task as I _____, he examined the previous work again.
ex.t: 26.他没有像我___那样着手新任务，而是又检查了之前的工作。

ex.s: 14．（1分）The workers were not better organized， otherwise they________the task in half the time．（  ）
ex.t: 14．（1分）工人们组织得不够好，否则他们________用一半时间完成任务。（  ）

ex.s: They conclude that when task interdependence is high，team performance will suffer when there is too much talent，while individual talent will have positive effects on team performance when task interdependence is lower.
ex.t: 他们得出结论：当任务相互依赖度高时，人才过多会损害团队表现；而当任务相互依赖度较低时，个人才华会对团队表现产生积极影响。

ex.s: This task interdependence distinguishes baseball from football and basketball.
ex.t: 这种任务相互依赖性使棒球区别于足球和篮球。

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师能打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和婚礼蛋糕上漂亮的装饰件。不是人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让它变得简单。西班牙一家餐厅用Foodini“重现”食物的“形状和部件”，做到“完全一致”，解放厨师去完成其他任务。另一家餐厅所有菜肴甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。

ex.s: With all the programs, teamwork is key as trainees learn the importance of leadership and being part of a bigger task.
ex.t: 在所有项目中，团队合作是关键，学员从中学习领导力和成为更大任务一部分的重要性。

ex.s: For new reporters, this can seem like a challenging task.
ex.t: 对新记者来说，这可能像一项有挑战的任务。

ex.s: So if we send out a robot with the single instruction of fetching coffee, it will have a strong desire to secure success by disabling its own off switch or even killing anyone who might interfere with its task.
ex.t: 所以，如果我们派出一个只接到“去取咖啡”这一指令的机器人，它会强烈渴望通过 disable 自己的关闭开关、甚至杀死任何可能干扰其任务的人来确保成功。

ex.s: The author, John Perry, said that procrastination was about 6___________ (avoid) the hardest and most important tasks.
ex.t: 作者约翰·佩里(John Perry)说,拖延是大约6           (避免)最困难和最重要的任务.

ex.t: 盟军最高司令艾森豪威尔将军向部队发布的一项命令说:“你的任务并不容易。

ex.t: 为了全力完成这项任务,鲁迅为自己制定了三条规则:没有海外旅行,没有参与其他书籍,没有兼职工作.

ex.s: As getting into space is however, still not an easy task, more and more space camps and other places are providing simulated space adventures.
ex.t: 然而,由于进入空间仍然不容易,越来越多的空间营地和其他地方正在提供模拟空间冒险。

ex.s: In one experiment carried out at the National University of Singapore, participants were given the task of learning concepts on a difficult subject.
ex.t: 在新加坡国立大学进行的一项实验中，参与者被赋予学习一门困难学科概念的任务。

ex.s: You would think learning takes more time from you, but actually there are always new ways of doing things that can save you time on daily tasks, freeing you up for the most important.
ex.t: 你会以为学习占用了你更多时间，但实际上总是有新的做事方式能节省日常任务的时间，让你腾出时间给最重要的事。

ex.s: But so far that is only true for the specific tasks for which the systems have been designed.
ex.t: 但到目前为止，这仅适用于这些系统被设计用来完成的具体任务。

ex.s: The Center offers programs designed to challenge and inspire with hands-on tasks and lots of fun.
ex.t: 该中心提供以动手任务和乐趣来挑战并激励人的项目。

defs.def: an activity which is designed to help achieve a particular learning goal, especially in language teaching （尤指语言教学中旨在帮助达到某一学习目的的）活动

ex.s: Studying a subject that you feel pointless is never a fun or easy task.
ex.t: 学习一门你觉得毫无意义的科目从来都不是有趣或容易的事。

ex.s: Trainees also get a good start on their Wilderness Survival badge as they learn about water- and land-survival through designed tasks and their search and rescue of “downed” pilot.
ex.t: 学员在通过设计任务及搜寻营救“坠机”飞行员学习水上和陆地生存时，也为野外生存徽章打下良好开端。
